charter.objective: Add the first workspace Mothership control-panel UI over the FeatureCase ledger-backed backend.
nonObjectives: Do not claim real provider or browser E2E.
Do not claim Docker image build or push proof.
Do not claim live Kubernetes service or CronJob proof.
Do not touch billing or provider-pricing runtime behavior.
invariants: The UI must consume the contract-bound control-panel backend through React Query.
The UI must show claims, non-claims, evidence, reviews, grade, blockers, next action, and hard-gate status.
Positive future proof claims must not be displayed as blocked hard gates.
Hard external gates remain non-claims until real proof exists.
proofRequired: Focused hook and UI tests pass.
API-boundary and React Query policy checks pass.
Local dev browser render shows the Mothership route and ledger-backed cases.
Reviewer-found gate-classification defect is fixed and covered by regression test.
stopRules: Stop on route-local API boundary schemas.
Stop on raw same-origin client fetch in the new hook.
Stop on visual overlap in the case list.
Stop on any claim that external hard gates are complete.

proves: Strict provider/browser hard-gate preflight unavailable because required env/secrets are missing
Docker image-build proof unavailable because the local Docker socket is missing
Kubernetes proof unavailable because kubectl is not installed
Control-panel backend returns success and ledger-backed cases during local dev server run
Scoped formatting and lint checks pass for the UI slice
Focused hook and UI gate-classifier tests pass
App TypeScript check passes after the UI slice
API boundary policy remains clean after adding the UI hook contract usage
React Query policy remains clean after adding the Mothership hook
FeatureCase checker accepts valid cases and rejects invalid over-claim fixtures
FeatureCase ledger checker validates the hash-chained ledger
Local dev browser render shows Mothership route, Cases summary, Browser/provider E2E gate, visible CLOSE_SAFE_PARTIAL decision, no failed-load state, and Docker/image proof blocked

blockers: Docker daemon unavailable for image-build proof.
kubectl unavailable for live Kubernetes proof.

findings: Initial gate classifier scanned claimsAdvanced and could mark future positive hard-gate claims as blocked; fixed by scanning only nonClaims and blockers and adding regression coverage.

grade.capReason: Safe local control-panel UI progress with focused tests and local browser-render proof; external provider/browser, Docker, and Kubernetes hard gates remain blocked.
claimsAdvanced: Workspace Mothership control-panel UI renders ledger-backed FeatureCases with search, summary counts, hard-gate status, case details, evidence commands, reviews, grade, blockers, non-claims, next action, and ledger metadata.

nextAction: If external hard gates remain unavailable, make the control panel an active closure cockpit with handoff/audit drill-through and subagent/Oracle review evidence panels.
